# From Prompt to Production

> מדריך ויזואלי בעברית (Hebrew, RTL) שמראה איך הופכים רעיון לעמוד נחיתה חי ב-Vercel,
> בעבודת פינג-פונג בין Claude ל-GPT, עם דגש על UI/UX, נגישות, ביצועים ו-SEO.

A Hebrew, single-page scrollytelling guide. It teaches a transferable workflow for building
and shipping a landing page with AI assistants and deploying it to Vercel.

## What this page covers
- Load UI/UX, accessibility, performance and SEO thinking before generating anything.
- Collect references and extract principles (not pixels).
- A Claude + GPT "ping-pong" loop: strategy, structure, copy, components, critique, deploy.
- Building the page in VS Code as a real React app.
- Deploying to Vercel (two paths: CLI/drag-drop, or GitHub auto-redeploy).

## Key links
- Author website: https://www.assafweb.com/
- Source of this guide and its skills: https://github.com/assaf0buskila/web-guide

## Notes for agents
- Language: Hebrew (he), direction RTL.
- This is an educational guide; the deployment steps are transferable to any Vite/React site.
